notes: The question asks for per-student CIP program code statistics (range, variance), but CIP program codes are a course/department-level attribute in SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION, not a student-level attribute. The available tables (SIS_SUBJECT_CODE, SIS_DEPARTMENT, MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION) do not include an enrollment table linking students to specific courses they take. Without knowing which courses each student is enrolled in, per-student CIP code statistics cannot be computed. The dense rank over school code is also ambiguous in this context since all Mathematics graduate students share the same school code.
